title: Jul 6, 2026·Global·NexonSecond Closed Online Test announced: sign-ups July 16, test runs Aug 4 to 12Nexon announced a second Closed Online Test for Global MapleStory Classic World. Sign-ups open on July 16. The test runs from August 4 to August 12. If you played in the first test, you still have to sign up again for a chance to join. You need a Nexon account to sign up, so make one now if you do not have one yet. Nexon says the official sign-up details are coming in the next week. The announcement went out on the official Facebook group and Instagram, along with a recap video of the first test.Closed Test
